findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_url, link_preview, smart_fetch, price_check · Private data: domain_dns, validate_email, extract_contacts · Public sink: validate_email · Destructive: convert_image, remove_image_background.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_url, link_preview, smart_fetch, price_check · Private data: domain_dns, validate_email, extract_contacts · Public sink: validate_email · Destructive: convert_image, remove_image_background

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
